title: Sand Chronicles
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: After her parents divorce, twelve-year-old Ann Uekusa moves with her mother from Tokyo to rural Shimane, where she befriends Daigo and the siblings Fuji and Shika. Her mother's suicide shapes the rest of Ann's life, which the story follows through first love, a long-distance relationship, breakups and family secrets into adulthood. After a broken engagement and her own suicide attempt, Ann reunites with Daigo, and they marry and have a son.
life_message: Grief can be survived with the patient love of family, friends and community, and happiness has to be chosen and rebuilt over time.

folkways.japan: The pull of the rural furusato (hometown) and close village oversight versus Tokyo anonymity reflects a common Japanese contrast.
